Dematic is a global leader in intelligent intralogistics and automated material handling solutions, delivering large-scale warehouse automation systems for some of the world’s leading brands. For decades, we’ve been redefining supply chains through innovation and cutting-edge automation technologies.  
  
We are looking for an OT Cybersecurity Compliance Lead who will be responsible for driving the cybersecurity of the operational technology (OT) systems delivered within the EMEA region. This covers Dematic systems throughout their lifecycle – from solution design and engineering to commissioning, handover and ongoing operation. You will work closely with project teams, solution engineering, customers and suppliers to embed security by design, manage cyber risk, and ensure that delivered automation systems meet customer requirements, company standards and applicable regulations.  
  
As the OT Cybersecurity Compliance Lead, you will drive, monitor and report on the compliance of OT systems with the EU Cyber Resilience Act and the Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, and apply ISA/IEC 62443 across projects in order to prevent, mitigate and / or detect cyber risks to delivered systems. You will be responsible for system-level security architecture, assurance and documentation within dedicated projects – a scope distinct from corporate IT security and from product-level cybersecurity, which are owned by separate functions.

# **We offer:**

* Career Development
* Competitive Compensation And Benefits
* Pay Transparency
* Global Opportunities

The base pay range for this role, at the time of posting, is estimated to be the following should this role be filled in the respective country:

**Italy:** €55,125 - €80,850 (Compensation will be aligned with the applicable National Collective Labour Agreement, namely the CBA , Metalmeccanico Industria)

**Lithuania:** €54,000 - €79,200

Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as work location, education, experience, knowledge, and skills.

# **Tasks and Qualifications:**

**What you'll be responsible for:**

* **Regulatory Compliance (Cyber Resilience Act & Machinery Regulation):**

  + Translate the EU Cyber Resilience Act and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 cybersecurity requirements into practical, auditable engineering and project requirements for OT systems.
  + Maintain readiness for the regulatory milestones (CRA vulnerability/incident reporting from September 2026 and full application December 2027; Machinery Regulation from January 2027).
  + Demonstrate system-level conformity where both regimes apply, reusing product-level assurance and closing the remaining integration gaps.
* **Secure-by-Design across the Project Lifecycle:**

  + Embed OT cybersecurity into the project lifecycle as gated, repeatable activities from design and engineering through FAT/SAT, commissioning and handover.
  + Author and review security requirements, architecture and risk assessments for bids and live projects, and advise project and solution teams.
  + Produce handover security documentation and the operations and maintenance security baseline inherited by the customer and Dematic Service.
* **OT Systems & Standards (IEC 62443):**

  + Apply ISA/IEC 62443 across OT systems – zones and conduits, network segmentation, secure remote access, hardening, patch and backup strategy.
  + Define reference architectures, hardening standards and reusable security building blocks so projects start from a compliant baseline.
* **Risk, Assurance and Testing:**

  + Conduct OT-specific risk assessments, security testing and assurance reviews; track findings and mitigations to closure across projects and the installed base.
  + Support OT security incident readiness and response for delivered systems, in coordination with IT Security and the customer.​
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:**

  + Act as the OT cybersecurity point of contact for project, engineering, quality, legal/compliance and customer stakeholders.
  + Provide guidance and training to project teams on OT security requirements and expectations.
* **Continuous Improvement:**

  + Capture lessons learned and feed them back into standards, reference designs and training.
  + Help build Dematic's OT cybersecurity capability so it scales with the project pipeline.
* **Compliance:**

  + Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, regulations and company policies.
  + Participate in internal and external audits as required.

**What we're looking for:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Automation, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in OT / ICS cybersecurity or industrial automation, ideally in a systems-integration, intralogistics, manufacturing or OEM environment.
* Working knowledge of ISA/IEC 62443 and OT/ICS security fundamentals (network segmentation, hardening, secure remote access, OT/IT interface).
* Familiarity with the EU Cyber Resilience Act and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (and the legacy Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC); awareness of NIS2.
* Familiarity with material handling systems, automation solutions, industrial control technology (PLC, SCADA, industrial networks) and supply chain logistics.
* Proven ability to write and produce technical and compliance reports.
* Experience embedding cybersecurity into the project and engineering lifecycle.
* Ability to oversee internal and external security and compliance audits.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to influence and collaborate with cross-functional teams in an international and matrix organization.
* Fluency in English (additional European languages are a plus).
* ISA/IEC 62443 certification (e.g. Cybersecurity Fundamentals, Risk Assessment or Design Specialist), GICSP, or an equivalent OT-security credential is an advantage.
* Willingness to travel internationally as required to support the role, up to 25% of the time.

**Are you an experienced software engineer who enjoys tackling complex technical problems? Do you thrive in collaborative environments and want to contribute to the development of new capabilities that have a real impact across a wider business?**

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the GCAP Enablers team and help develop innovative digital engineering capabilities that support the next generation of aerospace programmes. Working as part of a collaborative, multidisciplinary team, you will contribute to the design and development of software solutions that improve how engineering information is created, connected, and used across the product lifecycle.

You will work alongside software engineers, systems engineers, data specialists, and domain experts to solve complex challenges, while having opportunities to learn and apply modern technologies and approaches. This role is ideal for a software craftsman who is motivated by the challenge of building high-abstraction digital environments and is eager to apply their skills to a cutting-edge technical project.

**What you’ll bring**

You will help build the digital fabric that connects our distributed engineering landscape. By implementing a graph-based "Digital Thread," you will enable the seamless flow of enriched information across partners and teams, ensuring that our engineering ecosystem is resilient, scalable, and logically consistent.

* **Implementing the Digital Thread:** Developing software that transforms fragmented data from disparate sources into a unified, ontology-driven Knowledge Graph.
* **Enabling Composable Engineering:** Building a digital environment where relationships between engineering artefacts are first-class citizens, allowing for flexible and concurrent views of the system.
* **Solving Distributed Interoperability:** Creating mechanisms that allow tenuously connected environments and partners to contribute to a shared semantic representation without requiring rigid, point-to-point tool integration.
* **Driving Strategic Adoption:** Contributing to the overall strategy for the wider adoption of Knowledge Graphs and semantic technologies across the business to solve complex data challenges.
* **Ensuring Digital Rigour:** Implementing the configuration control and concurrency models that ensure the Digital Thread remains a reliable, authoritative source of truth at scale.

**What You’ll Do**

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key implementer of our digital engineering construct. You will move beyond "glue code" to build a high-abstraction layer based on semantic web principles.

**Semantic Implementation & Graph Engineering**

* Develop and maintain the software implementation of the Digital Thread using the **Semantic Web stack** (e.g., RDF, OWL, SPARQL).
* Build and optimise the graph databases and triple stores that house the engineering relationships and enrichments.
* Implement the logic that allows for the "enrichment" of data as it moves through the thread, adding semantic value and context.

**Adapter Development & Data Mapping**

* Develop tool adapters that map local data schemas to a global ontology, ensuring that tool-specific data is ingested into the graph without losing semantic meaning.
* Focus on "mapping to the model" rather than "mapping to the tool," preventing the proliferation of fragile, point-to-point integrations.

**Concurrency & Configuration Control**

* Architect and implement the versioning and configuration control mechanisms for the Digital Thread graph, ensuring that changes are traceable and concurrent access is managed.
* Develop software patterns that allow the graph to remain performant and consistent across a large, distributed programme.

**Technical Collaboration**

* Work closely with the Principal Systems Engineer to translate formal ontologies into performant software implementations.
* Collaborate with other software engineers to ensure the Digital Thread provides the exact enablers they need to achieve quality at pace.

* **Strong Coding Foundation:** Proven expertise in a modern language (e.g., **Python, Java, Node, or TypeScript**) with a deep commitment to software craftsmanship and clean code.
* **Complex Data Experience:** Experience handling data from heterogeneous, distributed sources. While experience with the **Semantic Web stack (RDF, OWL, SPARQL)** or **Graph Databases (Neo4j, GraphDB, Stardog, etc.)** is highly desirable, we value a strong engineering mindset and a willingness to learn these technologies.
* **Distributed Systems Knowledge:** An understanding of the challenges associated with "tenuously connected" digital environments and distributed data.
* **Software Craftsmanship:** A commitment to SOLID principles, maintainable architecture, and automated testing.

**私たちに関しては**

私たちは仕事に行くのが大好きなので、あなたも仕事に行くべきだと考えています。私たちのチームは信頼、顧客へのこだわり、機敏性を重視し、日々の改善に努めています。これらの価値観は当社の文化の基盤として機能し、当社の行動を導き、卓越性を目指して推進します。当社はパフォーマンスと評価の文化を育み、従業員がキャリアの中で最高の仕事をできるようにすることで成長を変革することができます。

このポジションはイギリスのロンドンにあります。オフィスはサウスバンクのウォータールー駅とブラックフライアーズ駅近くの好立地に位置しています。世界各地に展開する当社の「エネルギーセンター」は、生産性とコラボレーションを促進し、創造性を刺激し、つながりと祝賀の文化を育む拠点として機能しています。各チームは、それぞれの最適な働き方を反映させるため、エネルギーセンターでの活動時間を調整しています。 **フランス語が堪能な方、またはネイティブレベルの方で、英語も堪能な方を募集しています。**.

LogicMonitorでの生活について詳しくは、こちらをご覧ください。 キャリアページ.

あなたは何をやります

LogicMonitor®は、次世代のデジタルインフラストラクチャを支えるAIファーストのハイブリッド・オブザーバビリティ・プラットフォームです。オンプレミス、クラウド、エッジ環境全体にわたって、包括的な可視性と実用的なインテリジェンスを提供します。問題発生前に予測し、リソースをリアルタイムで最適化し、より迅速かつスマートな意思決定を可能にすることで、ITリーダーとビジネスリーダーは、利益率の確保、イノベーションの加速、そして妥協のない卓越したデジタルエクスペリエンスの提供を実現できます。

LogicMonitorは、クラウドと従来のITを統合して一元管理できる機能で、お客様から高い評価をいただいています。これは、顧客離脱率の低さ、事業拡大、そして新規顧客からの素晴らしい事例からも明らかです。実際、LogicMonitorはITインフラストラクチャ管理プロバイダーの中で最高のネットプロモータースコアを獲得しています。また、LogicMonitorは従業員満足度も非常に高く、Great Place To Work®の認定を受け、BuiltInの「働きがいのある会社」にも7年連続で選出されています。

シニアアカウントエグゼクティブの使命は、LogicMonitorのマネージドサービスプロバイダーエコシステム内で、新規の年間経常収益(ARR)の成長と戦略的パートナーの拡大を推進することです。

この役割は、見込み客の発掘と資格審査から、拡大、更新、長期的なアカウント開発に至るまで、販売ライフサイクル全体を担うことで、MSPパートナーの特定、関係構築、成長を促進する責任を負います。MSPの経営陣にとって信頼できるアドバイザーとして、パートナーがLogicMonitorを活用して業務効率を向上させ、サービス提供を拡大し、収益性の高い成長を促進できるよう支援します。

ターゲットとなる顧客アカウントとテリトリーモデルに基づいて業務を行い、経営幹部との関係を構築し、ビジネス上の課題を明らかにし、LogicMonitorのオブザーバビリティプラットフォームをパートナーのビジネス目標に合致させます。

この役割における成功は、ARR目標の継続的な達成、3~5倍の質の高いパイプラインカバレッジの創出と維持、戦略的なMSPパートナーの獲得、および長期的なパートナーの成長によって評価されます。

この重要な役割について、さらに詳しく見ていきましょう。

キーの責任:

**MSPパートナー獲得とパイプライン開発**

* アウトバウンドによる新規顧客開拓、パートナーからの紹介、マーケティング活動によって創出された機会、業界ネットワークの構築、戦略的なアカウントプランニングなどを通じて、年間目標の3~5倍に相当する質の高い営業パイプラインを構築・維持する。
* 高い潜在力を持つMSPパートナーを特定し、関係を構築することに重点を置いた地域計画を策定し、実行する。
* アウトバウンドプロスペクティング、パートナーからの紹介、マーケティング活動によって創出される機会、および業界ネットワークを通じてパイプラインを構築する。
* MSPのビジネスモデル、運用上の課題、成長戦略、および技術的な優先事項を理解するために、ヒアリング形式の対話を実施する。
* 確立された販売手法を用いて、商談機会を評価し、販売プロセスを通して進めていく。
* パイプライン創出目標、機会創出目標、および収益目標を継続的に達成する。
* 自ら開拓した見込み客やアカウント開発活動を通じて、パイプラインの大部分を構築する。

**パートナー関係管理**

* MSPの経営幹部、運用責任者、技術関係者との間で、信頼できるアドバイザーとしての関係を構築する。
* パートナー企業の事業目標、サービス内容、成長戦略について深く理解する。
* パートナー企業および顧客環境全体におけるLogicMonitorの導入拡大の機会を特定する。
* 主要パートナーと定期的に事業レビューおよび戦略計画策定会議を実施する。
* パートナーの健全性、エンゲージメント、成長機会を監視すると同時に、リスクに積極的に対処する。

**パートナーの支援と導入**

* パートナーのオンボーディング、イネーブルメント、および継続的な導入促進活動を支援する。
* LogicMonitorの機能、ベストプラクティス、および価値実現の機会についての認知度を高める。
* カスタマーサクセス、製品、マーケティングチームと連携し、パートナーの成果を最大化する。
* パートナー企業がLogicMonitorのプラットフォームを活用したサービス提供や市場投入戦略を策定できるよう支援する。
* 継続的な関わりと価値に基づいた対話を通じて、パートナーの長期的な成功を促進する。

**優れた営業力と市場専門知識**

* LogicMonitorのオブザーバビリティプラットフォーム、MSPビジネスモデル、および業界動向に関する専門知識を習得する。
* コンサルティング型および価値重視型の販売手法を適用してニーズを明らかにし、競合状況においてLogicMonitorの差別化を図る。
* MEDDPICCなどの資格認定フレームワークを活用して、取引の質と予測精度を向上させましょう。
* コーチング、能力開発、専門能力開発プログラムに積極的に参加する。
* 業界イベント、パートナーとの会合、役員会議において、LogicMonitorを代表する。

**必要なもの:**

**資格と要件**

* フランス語が堪能(ネイティブレベル)で、英語も堪能であることが必須です。
* 営業、パートナー管理、事業開発、または顧客対応型のテクノロジー関連職種において、8年以上の経験。
* SaaS、インフラストラクチャソフトウェア、クラウド、オブザーバビリティ、モニタリング、またはIT運用ソリューションの販売において、実績があること。
* マネージドサービスプロバイダー(MSP)、マネージドセキュリティサービスプロバイダー(MSSP)、またはITサービス組織との協業経験、あるいはこれらの組織への販売経験。
* 複雑な販売サイクルを通じて商談を管理しながら、パイプラインのカバー率を3~5倍に構築・維持できる実績。
* 優れた情報収集能力、資格審査能力、交渉力、そして契約締結能力。
* 技術関係者と経営幹部の両方を惹きつける能力。
* MEDDPICC、Command of the Message、Force Managementなどの体系的な販売手法、または類似のフレームワークを活用した経験。
* 優れたコミュニケーション能力、プレゼンテーション能力、および人間関係構築能力。
* CRMの規律、予測、実行に細心の注意を払いながら、優れた組織能力を発揮できる。
* パートナーと顧客の成功に尽力する、協調的な考え方。

# Security Engineer (Product & Cloud)

LoopSmart is a technology research and development company. We build advanced software, AI systems, and infrastructure that power our partners' products. We focus on creating tangible technology solutions that solve complex problems at scale.

We are seeking a Security Engineer to help keep our systems safe without slowing delivery. In this role, you will focus on pragmatic controls for product and cloud systems: access boundaries, threat modeling, and security-by-design practices. You will work with engineering to identify real risks early and design controls that fit the system, prioritizing clear documentation over checkbox compliance.

You will be responsible for the security posture of our assets: from designing the IAM policies that protect our data to defining the secure SDLC practices that prevent vulnerabilities. You will act as an enabler, providing the tools and guidance that make it easy for engineers to do the right thing.

* Design and review IAM boundaries (least privilege, role separation, and access lifecycle).

* Define secure SDLC practices: code scanning where helpful, dependency hygiene, and secure review patterns.

The Corporate Services function, spanning Real Estate & Workplace, Sustainability/ESG, Insurance and Travel & Expense Management, has close ties with all the businesses, Finance, Procurement and IT to ensure that Marex sources the right goods, services and data, maintains controls and permissions around distribution, and apportions costs. A strong desire to learn and be curious, with eagerness to get involved with the various businesses and teams, is essential. You will be process driven, analytical, and comfortable working across data, reporting, and stakeholder coordination.

**Responsibilities**

**Sustainability & ESG Data**

* Getting hands-on experience with the **full ESG reporting cycle**, from data collection and validation through to analysis, commentary, and senior stakeholder reporting.

* Exploring a wide range of **ESG datasets**, including facilities, utilities, business travel, suppliers, spend, headcount, vehicles, and other business activity data.
* Using **sustainability reporting platforms and data tools** to improve accuracy, streamline processes, and support audit-ready reporting.
* Helping translate complex data into clear insights, trends, and narrative for **governance forums, sustainability updates, and management reporting**.
* Supporting **controls, documentation, and audit trails** that strengthen confidence in the Group’s ESG reporting.
* Contributing fresh ideas to **automation, process improvement**, and the integration of new offices, acquisitions, and emerging reporting requirements.

**Real Estate & Workplace Support**

* Getting involved in the management of a **global real estate and workplace portfolio**, from lease data and key dates through to office planning, supplier coordination, and day-to-day operational support.
* Supporting **lease administration** by maintaining accurate records, tracking important milestones, and helping ensure the business has clear visibility of upcoming obligations and opportunities.
* **Working with workplace, facilities, finance, procurement, and external partners** to support smooth office operations and high-quality service delivery.
* Using **real estate, workplace, and facilities systems** to improve data quality, track contracts and suppliers, and support better portfolio decision-making.
* Assisting with **budgets, purchase orders, invoice coding, and cost tracking** to understand how workplace services are planned, controlled, and reported.
* Bringing a fresh perspective to **process improvement, reporting, and coordination** across the Real Estate & Workplace function.

**Insurance Administration Support**

* Getting involved in the coordination of **global insurance renewal processes**, supporting the collection of information, review of submissions, and preparation of renewal materials across key regions.
* Building an understanding of **core insurance programmes**, including financial lines, property, liability, cyber, travel, and other business-critical coverages.
* Maintaining accurate **policy records, key date trackers, certificates, premium information, and broker correspondence** to support effective governance and oversight.
* **Working with brokers, insurers, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and business teams** to help ensure insurance requirements are understood, documented, and managed effectively.
* Supporting the **onboarding of new entities, offices, and acquisitions** into the Group insurance framework, helping ensure coverage remains aligned with the evolving business.
* Assisting with **data gathering, policy analysis, invoice coordination, claims administration, and management reporting** across the insurance portfolio.
* Contributing fresh ideas to improve **insurance tracking, documentation, renewal planning, and internal processes** across the Group.

* Maintaining **expense approval workflows** and updating data within the Travel & Expense platform.
* Coordinating with the **Travel Management Company** on hotel rate loading.
* **Ensuring bookings comply with policy** and managing queries alongside the T&E Manager and Accounts Payable team.

**Competencies**

* Good organisational skills and ability to work well under pressure and stringent timelines.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Good Excel skills and ability to analyse complex data sets
* A collaborative team player, approachable, self-efficient and influences a positive work environment
* Demonstrates curiosity
* Resilient in a challenging, fast-paced environment
* Excels at building relationships, networking and influencing others
* Strategic collaborator with insight and agility, able to anticipate future challenges, ensuring operational effectiveness

**Skills and Experience**

* Educated to degree level, or equivalent, in a relevant discipline such as business, real estate, sustainability, finance, or a related field.

* Self-motivated with strong analytical skills and confidence using data, spreadsheets, and reporting tools across a range of subject areas.

* Problem solving skills along with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, both verbally and in writing.

Bring up claims with your manager as appropriate for advice on strategy or reserving. Observe, review, and ensure targets are met.

* Produce good quality and informative narratives and information on key claims and claims developments.

* Show a willingness to lead claims across all business types handled by the team. This includes attending underwriting meetings, learning about each class, and building relationships with key collaborators involved in the claims process.
* Assist the Claims Manager with specific ad hoc projects and provide innovative ways of doing things as required. Be willing to assist beyond the day-to-day claims handling to further develop the team and book of business as a whole.

**Key Skills:**

Identify and discuss the most common areas and trends in claims causation. Segment and analyze the portfolio to assist in identifying the most profitable sub-segments and those areas where remedial action should be taken. Understand, monitor, provide feedback, and ensure alignment with important metrics.
* Analyze and interpret data to improve Markel’s underwriting capabilities (e.g., loss performance and underwriting efficiency). Scope out problems/questions for analysis and work with actuarial/underwriting/claims manager or head of class to investigate.
* Assist underwriters with the development of policy language to achieve desired coverage and propose wording amendments to manager and/or underwriters.
* Understand customer needs and actively seek and respond to feedback, offering solutions to problems. Build relationships beyond the claim's function, including underwriters, brokers, and key legal providers.
* Negotiate intricate coverage issues calmly and effectively in the interests of all parties. Competently represent MINT in handling market and broker meetings.
* Support the training of junior members of the claims team, offering insight into particular claims areas and aiding them in building their own skills.
* Background and knowledge in Marine Liability is required.
* You will have achieved ACII accreditation or be working towards it.

* A great starting salary plus annual bonus & strong benefits package...
* Up to 16% company pension scheme,
* Private medical and dental cover, Menopause plan, emergency care benefit (children/Pets/dependants)
* Income protection, Life assurance, electric car scheme, travel insurance
* 25 days paid holiday plus Bank Holidays, with the opportunity to buy/sell extra leave
* As well as other great benefits on offer there are countless opportunities to learn new skills and develop in your career!

If you’re looking for a place where you can make a meaningful difference, you’ve found it. **Role Purpose**

The Oracle Fusion HCM & Payroll Data Migration Lead is responsible for leading and executing the end-to-end data migration lifecycle for Oracle Fusion implementations. The role works closely with customer data teams, business stakeholders and HCM/Payroll functional consultants to define what data is required, how legacy data must be extracted, how it maps to Oracle Fusion, and how it is transformed, loaded, reconciled and validated.

**This is a hands-on delivery role, not a coordination-only position.** The successful candidate is expected to personally create and review migration files, perform Oracle Fusion data loads, analyse load failures, correct and reload data, develop reconciliation outputs, investigate data quality issues and provide clear explanations and recommendations to both customer and project teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Data Migration Planning and Cycle Leadership**

* Own and drive the data migration workstream across mock migrations, testing cycles, cutover rehearsals and production migration.
* Create and maintain detailed data migration plans covering extraction, mapping, transformation, file preparation, load, validation, reconciliation, defect resolution and rework.
* Define migration milestones, dependencies, entry/exit criteria, ownership and delivery checkpoints for each data object.
* Track migration progress, risks, data defects, decisions and actions, escalating issues that could impact the wider implementation plan.
* Coordinate with programme, customer, functional, technical, testing and business teams while retaining direct ownership of migration delivery.

**2. Customer Extraction Requirements and Legacy Data Analysis**

* Work closely with customer data/extraction teams to define the exact data required from the legacy system for each Oracle Fusion object.
* Translate Oracle Fusion functional and technical requirements into clear legacy extraction specifications, including required fields, selection criteria, effective dating, historical data rules, filters, defaults and valid values.
* Review customer-generated extracts for completeness, structure, data quality and fitness for migration before transformation and load activities begin.
* Analyse source data to identify duplicates, missing mandatory values, invalid dates, broken relationships, inconsistent codes, referential integrity issues and other migration risks.
* Provide actionable feedback to the customer on extraction issues and support iterative correction of source extracts.

**3. Legacy-to-Fusion Mapping and Migration Design**

* Create, maintain and mature mapping documents that establish field-level and value-level mappings between legacy systems and Oracle Fusion.
* Document source fields, Fusion target attributes, transformation rules, defaulting logic, lookup/value mappings, effective-date handling, derivation logic and business rules.
* Work with HCM and Payroll functional consultants to confirm target configuration, mandatory attributes, business rules, reference data and downstream dependencies.
* Ensure changes agreed during migration cycles, defect resolution or functional design discussions are reflected in migration mapping and transformation documentation.
* Identify gaps where legacy data cannot directly support Fusion requirements and define pragmatic transformation, cleansing or defaulting approaches with the relevant stakeholders.

**4. Hands-on Data Preparation, Transformation and Oracle Fusion Loading**

* Prepare Oracle Fusion migration templates and load-ready files from customer-provided legacy extracts.
* Perform data manipulation, transformation, enrichment, formatting and validation using SQL, Excel and other suitable analytical or data-processing tools.
* Create and execute HCM Data Loader (HDL) files and, where appropriate, HCM Spreadsheet Data Loader (HSDL) or other Oracle-supported loading mechanisms.
* Manage load sequencing and dependencies between related HCM and Payroll objects to ensure data is loaded in the correct order.
* Execute loads in Oracle Fusion, review load status and logs, identify failed records, investigate root causes, correct data or file structures and perform re-loads until agreed acceptance criteria are achieved.
* Differentiate between source-data, mapping, transformation, configuration, environment and load-mechanism issues and route or resolve them appropriately.
* Provide clear technical and business justification for rejected or failed records and recommend the required corrective action.

**5. Reconciliation, Validation and Data Quality Assurance**

* Develop, modify and execute reconciliation reports comparing source data, prepared migration files and successfully loaded Oracle Fusion data.
* Use SQL and Oracle Fusion reporting tools such as BI Publisher and OTBI to validate migrated data and identify variances.
* Create object-level validation reports covering record counts, key totals, critical attributes, balances, relationships and other business-significant measures.
* Perform detailed analytical review of migration results rather than relying only on load success percentages.
* Investigate reconciliation differences, identify root causes and drive corrective action through source correction, transformation changes, configuration updates or reload.
* Support business validation by supplying clear reports, exception lists, evidence and explanations that enable customer sign-off.

**6. Functional, Business and Technical Collaboration**

* Partner with Oracle Fusion HCM and Payroll functional consultants to understand configuration, statutory/legislative requirements, functional dependencies and object-specific migration requirements.
* Translate functional requirements into data requirements that customer extraction teams can understand and implement.
* Work directly with business users to clarify legacy data meaning, validate transformation assumptions and resolve data exceptions.
* Collaborate with reporting, integration, security and technical teams where migrated data affects downstream processes or reconciliation.
* Act as the primary data migration point of contact for assigned HCM/Payroll areas and provide confident, evidence-based updates to stakeholders.

**7. Migration Governance and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain clear auditability of migration rules, mapping decisions, file versions, load results, reconciliation evidence and outstanding exceptions.
* Establish repeatable migration processes, templates, checklists and quality controls across migration cycles.
* Perform root-cause analysis on recurring migration issues and introduce preventative controls for subsequent cycles.
* Support cutover planning by defining final extraction windows, load sequence, estimated processing activities, reconciliation steps and business sign-off requirements.
* Contribute to migration closure reporting, lessons learned and transition of migration knowledge into support or BAU teams where required.

## About Maze

**Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.**

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the *right* product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the **#1 user research platform** in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

We’re hiring a **Senior Site Reliability Engineer** to join our Platform team and help us build secure, reliable, and scalable systems as Maze grows.

This role sits at the intersection of **cloud infrastructure, reliability, and security**. You’ll work across our platform to improve how we operate production systems, strengthen our security practices, and give engineers the tooling and infrastructure they need to ship quickly and confidently.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys working across boundaries, takes ownership, and brings a pragmatic approach to solving problems. You don’t need to be an expert in every part of our stack, but you should be excited to learn, move quickly, and make an impact.

## **We’re looking for someone who:**

* Has experience building and operating production systems in a modern cloud environment, ideally AWS
* Understands modern SRE and infrastructure practices, including infrastructure as code and containerized workloads

* **Security & compliance:** Vanta, Socket
* **CI/CD:** GitHub Actions, Argo CD
* **Data:** PostgreSQL, Neo4j, Snowflake

At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture.

Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. We are informed by data and regularly check our salary ranges (either United States or Rest of World) against other venture backed companies. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package.

Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations.

* **Early-stage startup:** You will join an early-stage startup with less than 150 team members. This means you'll have the unique opportunity to directly impact success and help shape the future of Maze.

But there's finally a groundswell building around a path forward that eliminates this compromise - and Maze is leading the charge.

**Profile Summary**

Mizuho EMEA is seeking an experienced AML/KYC Quality Control (QC) professional at Assistant Vice President (AVP) level to lead the delivery of high-quality client due diligence across its corporate and institutional banking business.

Sitting within the first line of defence, the role provides independent, risk-based review and challenge of KYC files and associated controls, ensuring alignment with internal policy, regulatory expectations, and agreed risk appetite. The AVP will act as a quality leader for the function, setting clear standards, driving timely remediation, and reducing repeat issues through coaching, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement. The role will also support the development of management information (MI), oversee adherence to QC methodology and scoring, and escalate material risks and control weaknesses where required.

The successful candidate will combine deep technical KYC expertise with a pragmatic, risk-based mindset and the ability to influence stakeholders across Operations, Financial Crime, Compliance, and the front office. They will be comfortable leading challenge conversations, presenting themes and recommendations in governance forums, and driving sustained improvements in quality, timeliness, and control effectiveness.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

Quality Control, Oversight & Challenge

* Conduct independent, risk-based quality reviews of KYC/CDD/EDD files across a range of entity types, products and risk levels, ensuring completeness, accuracy and consistency
* Apply and, where appropriate, enhance the QC methodology (checklist, scoring and sample selection), ensuring it remains aligned to policy, regulatory expectations and risk appetite
* Provide effective challenge and identify material gaps, inconsistencies and potential financial crime risks, escalating higher-risk issues and control concerns in line with governance requirements
* Ensure KYC files and remediation outcomes are fit for internal/external scrutiny (audit, regulators, QA) and support resolution of challenged findings through evidence-based rationale

Coaching, Standards & Quality Improvement

* Partner with Team Leads and KYC Analysts to plan and prioritise remediation and production activity, ensuring delivery against service levels, risk priorities and stakeholder expectations
* Provide structured feedback, mentoring and on-the-job coaching to improve quality outcomes, capability and consistency across the team
* Identify recurring issues through thematic analysis and QC MI, escalate trends, and recommend improvements across process, guidance, controls and technology
* Support and/or lead the development of quality standards, operating procedures, and training materials; contribute to calibration sessions to ensure consistent application of policy

Stakeholder Management

* Engage effectively with Analysts, Team Leads, Financial Crime, Compliance and front office stakeholders to ensure quality requirements are understood and embedded
* Clearly articulate and justify QC decisions, including in formal challenge forums, ensuring outcomes are evidence-based and aligned to risk appetite
* Build strong working relationships and credibility to support a collaborative, high-performance culture and effective management of issues and escalations

Process Improvement & Change

* Contribute to, and where required lead, process enhancements and efficiency initiatives across KYC operations, balancing control effectiveness with operational practicality
* Provide input into policy and procedure updates, control frameworks and system improvements; support control design and testing where applicable
* Support implementation of regulatory or internal change initiatives, including impact assessment, communication, training and embedding of new requirements

Operational Flexibility

* Act as a flexible resource within the team, providing oversight and hands-on support during peak periods and for higher-risk/complex cases where required
* Maintain strong awareness of workload priorities, delivery timelines and key risk themes, escalating capacity constraints and issues as appropriate

**Qualifications, Skills and Experience**

Core Experience

* Minimum 5+ years’ experience in AML/KYC operations and/or financial crime controls within banking or financial services, including exposure to corporate and institutional client due diligence
* Strong track record completing and/or reviewing complex KYC (CDD/EDD) for corporate and institutional clients, with the ability to provide effective challenge and decision support
* Experience across a wide range of entity types and structures (including multi-jurisdictional and layered ownership), such as:

+ Listed and non-listed corporates
+ Regulated and non-regulated financial institutions
+ Funds and asset managers
+ Private equity structures
+ SPVs, Trusts, and complex ownership structures

Technical Knowledge

* Strong understanding of financial crime risk (AML, CTF, sanctions) and how it applies in practice
* Good knowledge of corporate and investment banking products and associated risk profiles
* Understanding of global KYC standards, with exposure to EMEA regulatory environments (UK, EU, UAE beneficial)

Quality & Risk Mindset

* High attention to detail combined with strong judgement and a pragmatic, risk-based approach appropriate for AVP-level decision-making
* Ability to distinguish between material risk issues and minor technical findings
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability for quality outcomes, including escalation of material issues and contribution to governance reporting

Communication & Stakeholder Skills

* Ability to provide clear, constructive feedback, influence outcomes, and challenge appropriately at peer and senior levels
* Confident in explaining and defending QC decisions to stakeholders, including supporting responses to audit, regulatory or second line enquiries where required
* Collaborative team player with a coaching-oriented mindset

Adaptability & Continuous Improvement

* Comfortable working in a dynamic environment with evolving regulatory expectations
* Proactive in identifying opportunities to improve processes and controls
* Open to change and able to adapt quickly to new requirements

Desirable

* Demonstrable experience in a Quality Control / Quality Assurance or oversight function within KYC, Financial Crime, or Client Lifecycle Management
* Strong knowledge of EMEA regulatory frameworks and supervisory expectations (e.g. FCA, EBA, UAE Central Bank), and how they translate into practical KYC controls
* Proven exposure to audit, regulatory reviews and remediation programmes, including drafting responses and tracking actions to closure
* Relevant certifications (e.g. ICA, ACAMS) or commitment to obtaining them

London

## **About Modo Energy**

The energy transition is the biggest infrastructure buildout in human history. Modo Energy is the data platform at the centre of it.

We build the benchmarking, forecasting, and valuation tools that the world's most serious energy investors, developers, and operators depend on to make decisions. If a battery gets financed, built, or traded anywhere in the world, there's a good chance Modo data was in the room.

Founded in 2019, we're 80+ people across London, New York, Sydney, and Madrid; $30M Series B, AI-native, and moving fast.

This is a rare chance to join a category-defining company at the moment it's scaling globally.

## **The Role**

Modo Energy's engineering team builds the systems behind the Modo Terminal, the data, research, and agentic platform that energy market professionals rely on every day. We're growing fast, and our ambitions are growing faster: from serving data and research to letting users (and their AI agents) query, forecast, and act on it directly.

We're hiring backend Python engineers to join one of our product teams: Terminal, Data, Ko (our AI Analyst), or Modelling. Each team owns a business capability end-to-end, including its own APIs, data pipelines, AWS infrastructure, and developer tooling. Wherever you land, you'll be building production systems from day one, with ownership over what you ship and how.

We're looking for engineers who learn fast and go wide. You won't be boxed into a single layer of the stack; the best people on our teams move fluidly between building a feature, hardening a pipeline, fixing an infra issue, and automating away the next one. If you're the kind of engineer who picks up a new tool, library, or part of the codebase without needing much of a runway, this is built for you.

## **What You'll Do**

* Build and maintain backend services and APIs, on Django, FastAPI, or similar, that power a live product used daily by energy market professionals.
* Design and operate data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve energy market data reliably and at scale.
* Own AWS infrastructure and deployment end-to-end using Terraform, from local development through to production.
* Build the monitoring, observability, and alerting that let your team catch problems before customers do.
* Split your time between shipping new features and keeping the platform healthy. Maintenance, performance, and production issues are a normal, expected part of the job, not an interruption to it.
* Design internal tools such as CLIs, APIs, and MCP servers that make your team and others faster, and that let both humans and AI agents work with our data safely and effectively.
* Work directly with the people who understand the domain (energy analysts, data scientists, modellers) to make sure what you build is accurate and actually useful.
* Contribute to the infrastructure behind our LLM-powered AI Analyst as needed: retrieval pipelines, tool-calling, and the plumbing that lets models work with real energy market data.
* Cross into the parts of the stack outside your core comfort zone when the team needs it, whether that's a bit of frontend or a bit of deeper infra, and pick up what you don't already know.

## **What We’re Looking For**

***The Essentials***

* 3+ years of professional Python experience, with strong backend fundamentals. You write clean, well-structured code and are comfortable owning something end-to-end, from design through deployment and monitoring.
* Real, hands-on experience with AWS and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform). You've run production infrastructure, not just experimented with it.
* Proficiency with Django, FastAPI, or a comparable async Python framework.
* Experience with data pipelines and relational databases (PostgreSQL), and building systems that serve data reliably at scale.
* Expert-level use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar). You know when to trust them, when to intervene, and how to get real leverage from them. We write a lot of code this way.
* A fast learner with good judgement, comfortable making calls on system design and what's good enough to ship, and genuinely energized by picking up unfamiliar tools, stacks, or problem areas rather than staying in one lane.
* Comfortable in a small, fast-moving team where you're expected to figure things out, make trade-offs, and ship, with real autonomy over how.

***Nice to have***

* Experience with LLM-powered applications: RAG pipelines, tool-calling architectures, or agentic systems.
* Experience designing external-facing APIs, including versioning, backwards compatibility, and OpenAPI/REST standards.
* Familiarity with data infrastructure such as Airflow, Spark, Iceberg, or Kafka.
* Experience with energy markets.

At Modo Energy, we believe that exceptional work deserves exceptional reward. We're a high-performance team; ambitious, collaborative, and genuinely motivated by the scale of what we're trying to build.

You'll have real ownership from day one, work alongside some of the brightest people in the industry, and be part of a company that's defining a new category in the global energy market. # Senior Financial Control Analyst

London

***🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.***

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

---

**Senior Financial Control Analyst**

📍London/Cardiff | 💰£60,000 - £65,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

**⭐ Our Financial Control Team:**

Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges!

Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.

**🔑 You’ll play a key role by...**

We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.

We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.

**Your day-to-day:**

* Help embed our software capitalisation process working closely with our engineering and business teams to create an automated and scalable solution.
* Take on the role of product owner for the financial reporting processes of software capitalisation, operating key controls across month end close and performing impairment assessments.
* Use your strong technical knowledge of relevant IFRS standards for capitalisation and impairment to support and challenge the business on areas of judgement and documentary evidence.
* Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.
* Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.
* Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.
* Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.
* Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.
* Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system
* Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched
* Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data
* Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!

**🤩 We’d love to hear from you if...**

* You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment
* You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards
* You have a great eye for detail
* You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls
* You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors
* You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds
* You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)
* You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment
* What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰£60,000 - £65,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

## **Department Overview**

CRFS was founded in 2007 with a mission to provide the best actionable RF intelligence across the widest possible frequency range in any environment. Our software defined radios and solutions are used worldwide by the military, government agencies, system integrators and national spectrum regulators to capture, detect and geolocate signals they care about, enabling real-time intelligence and spectrum supremacy.

## Job Description

**This role requires you to be onsite in Cambourne 3 days per week.**

We are looking for a technical copywriter to help transform technical and operational information into clear, B2B value propositions and communications.

This role is suited to someone who enjoys storytelling and sophisticated technology, and turning structured briefs and conversations into elevators, concepts and short content across multiple formats.

You must be intellectually curious, comfortable working with technical subject matter, and able to quickly absorb and accurately communicate complex information in a hierarchy making it compelling and concise.

You will work closely with stakeholders from product management, engineering, sales, marketing and operations as well as senior leadership to produce content related to RF technology and defence systems for UK and NATO allies.

This is primarily a concept, creative conception, writing and editorial role—supporting the VP Marketing and the Marketing Engagement Director. You will also review and support a network of international writers and contributors writing about everything from air defense to border security monitoring, drone detection, unmanned system capability, signal capture, AI and ML

## Basic Requirements

### **Key Responsibilities**

* High-Quality B2B Content Production: Produce high-quality written B2B content at pace from both written and oral briefs.
* Technical Translation: Convert complex technical and operational information into clear, audience-appropriate communications.
* Content Generation and Editing: Write, edit, and refine a diverse range of formats, including:

  + Presentations
  + Website copy
  + Short how-to articles and knowledge base pieces
  + Executive summaries and internal reports
  + Email campaigns
  + Briefing and sales enablement documents
  + Product messaging and Account-Based Marketing (ABM) content
  + Event and campaign support collateral
* SME Interviewing: Interview internal and external subject matter experts to extract critical, relevant information.
* Editorial Refinement: Significantly improve the clarity, structure, readability, and flow of complex technical materials.
* Audience Adaptation: Adapt tone, style, and messaging hierarchy for distinct target audiences, including:

  + Senior military leadership
  + Military and non-military operators
  + Program managers and technical buyers
  + Commercial managers, platform, and economic buyers
  + Procurement and compliance teams
* Brand Consistency: Maintain meticulous consistency across all global messaging and written outputs.
* Information Synthesis: Translate rough notes, transcripts, raw presentations, and unstructured discussions into polished, succinct copy.
* Value-Driven Content: Ensure all finalized content is technically accurate, engaging, and strongly benefit-led.

### **What We Are Looking For**

* Exceptional Writing and Creative Conception: Proven ability to craft compelling copy and develop creative communication concepts.
* Concise Short-Form Editing: Strong editing skills with a focus on punchy, high-impact short-form content.
* Technical Agility: Superb ability to absorb highly complex technical information quickly and simplify it without losing accuracy.
* Commercial and Listening Intelligence: Strong listening skills combined with sharp commercial intelligence to extract the critical business value from conversations.
* Meticulous Attention to Detail: An uncompromising eye for precision, accuracy, and detail.
* Ambiguity Management: Comfortably working and delivering results from incomplete or evolving information.
* SME Interviewing: Experience researching and confidently interviewing technical subject matter experts.
* Professional Communication: A highly polished, professional, and clear communication style.

### **Desirable Attributes**

* Experience: 7+ years of relevant experience in a specialized writing or editorial role.
* Background: An advertising, content marketing, or technical journalism background.
* Fast-Paced Collaboration: A proven track record of working collaboratively at a fast pace.

## Job Description

Shape the financial success of major projects

We're looking for a Lead Project Cost Controller to join our Project Controls team and play a key role in the successful delivery of complex, high-value projects.

In this role, you'll provide strategic cost leadership, partnering with Project Managers, Commercial teams, Finance, and senior stakeholders to ensure projects remain financially robust from planning through to completion. You'll lead forecasting, performance analysis, reporting, and cost governance activities while helping drive informed decision-making across the project lifecycle.

This is an excellent opportunity for a cost control professional who enjoys combining financial insight, stakeholder engagement, and team leadership to influence project outcomes.

What you'll be doing

As Lead Project Cost Controller, you will:

* Lead project cost management activities across large and complex programmes.
* Establish and maintain effective cost control frameworks, including Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) and Cost Breakdown Structures (CBS).
* Manage project budgets, cost baselines, change control processes, and forecasting activities.
* Produce and maintain accurate Estimate at Completion (EAC) and Estimate to Complete (ETC) forecasts.
* Analyse project performance using Earned Value Management (EVM) principles and key performance indicators.
* Identify cost trends, risks, and opportunities, providing recommendations to support project delivery.
* Prepare clear and meaningful financial reports, dashboards, and performance insights for senior stakeholders.
* Support cash flow forecasting, commitment tracking, and expenditure monitoring.
* Collaborate with Finance teams to ensure alignment between project reporting and financial records.

# Senior Safety Consultant

**Why Adelard?**

Adelard is a place for people who like thinking carefully about difficult systems.

We work on problems where the answer is not always “follow the process”. Standards matter, but so do evidence, context, engineering judgement and clarity of thought. Our clients come to us because they need independent advice they can understand and trust.

You will work with experienced specialists, contribute to meaningful projects, and develop your ability to assess, explain and defend technical positions in critical domains.

As part of NCC Group, Adelard offers the opportunity to work within a specialist technical consultancy while benefiting from the reach and support of a larger organisation.

**Work On Systems Where Getting It Right Matters**

Adelard helps organisations understand, justify and improve the safety, security and trustworthiness of critical computer-based systems.

We undertake research into engineering assurance methods, exploring how safety standards can be applied effectively in new contexts and where existing guidance requires careful interpretation. This research helps shape the application of standards in certain industries, contributing to the wider development of safety engineering as a practice.

Our work sits at the point where engineering evidence, risk, assurance and judgement meet. We work with clients in sectors such as nuclear, defence, medical, rail, air traffic control, finance and critical infrastructure. The systems we assess are often complex, software-intensive and important enough that vague assurance is not good enough.

We are looking for a Senior Safety Consultant who enjoys difficult technical questions.

Questions such as:

* Does this evidence really support the safety claim being made?
* Has the system behaviour been understood well enough?
* Are the assumptions valid?
* Is the argument convincing, or merely compliant-looking?
* What would a proportionate, defensible engineering position look like?
* How can we explain the issue clearly enough that the client can act on it?

This role would suit someone who likes moving between detail and judgement: reading technical evidence, understanding system behaviour, challenging weak arguments, applying standards intelligently, and helping clients make better decisions about critical systems.

## Key Responsibilities

You will work on varied consultancy projects involving safety-critical and security-relevant systems.

Your work may include:

* Reviewing software, system designs, test evidence, analysis results, assurance cases and safety arguments.
* Assessing whether critical systems have been adequately engineered, analysed and justified.
* Supporting hazard analysis, risk assessment, independent review and compliance assessment.
* Applying standards and regulations in a thoughtful, proportionate way.
* Developing clear technical positions on complex or ambiguous evidence.
* Research into the application of safety standards to low complexity and low criticality product developments.
* Writing reports that are rigorous, readable and useful.
* Explaining findings to clients, project teams and senior stakeholders.
* Using analysis techniques such as static analysis, dynamic analysis, model checking, formal methods, testing or modelling where appropriate.
* Developing scripts, tools, models or analysis approaches to support the work.
* Working with colleagues across safety, security, software, systems engineering, formal methods and assurance.
* Supporting the development of less experienced consultants.

The work is varied. One project might involve reviewing a safety case. Another might involve examining software analysis results. Another might require helping a client interpret a standard, understand a technical risk, or decide what evidence is needed to justify a claim.

We do not expect you to arrive knowing everything. We do expect you to be technically curious, careful in your reasoning, and willing to learn.

## Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

The best people in this role are not just technically competent. They are thoughtful, clear and constructively sceptical.

They can read a document and notice the claim that does not quite follow. They can look at a test result and ask what it proves, what it does not prove, and what assumption is hiding underneath it. They can disagree without grandstanding. They can give advice that is technically defensible and practically useful.

You should be able to:

* Understand how computer-based systems are designed, implemented, tested and assured.
* Interpret complex technical material.
* Identify weak evidence, unsupported claims and unclear reasoning.
* Form independent, evidence-based opinions.
* Explain your thinking clearly in writing and in discussion.
* Work pragmatically without losing technical integrity.
* Move between system-level concerns and low-level technical detail.
* Handle several projects or workstreams at once.
* Build trust with clients and colleagues.
* Contribute to a team of specialists with different areas of expertise.

You may have a background in software engineering, systems engineering, safety engineering, assurance, formal methods, electronics, mathematics, physics or another technical discipline.

Experience in any of the following would be useful:

* Safety-critical, mission-critical or high-integrity systems.
* Embedded software, software assurance or systems engineering.
* Safety assessment, hazard analysis, independent review or assurance cases.
* Static analysis, formal methods, model checking, verification or validation.
* Standards such as IEC 61508, ISO 26262, DO-178C, EN 50128, IEC 62304 or related frameworks.
* Regulated sectors such as nuclear, defence, rail, aerospace, medical devices, automotive, finance, air traffic control or critical infrastructure.
* Safety and security co-engineering.
* Tool development, scripting, modelling or automation.

You do not need experience in all these areas. A strong technical foundation, good judgement and the ability to learn are more important than a perfect keyword match.  
 **Clearance and Travel**

It is useful if you already hold, or are eligible to obtain, UK security clearance. A safety, security or critical systems background would be beneficial, but we will provide suitable training for candidates with the right technical aptitude.

The role may involve occasional travel within the UK and, in some cases, to Europe or the US.

AI Evaluation & Benchmarking

# Manager, Finance Operations - Contract to Cash

London

## About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

## About the Role

We are hiring a Manager, Finance Operations - Contract-to-Cash to build and run Nscale’s operating layer for approved commercial commitments, converting signed deals into controlled billing readiness, revenue recognition inputs, cash visibility, and finance-owned execution reporting.

Sitting at the intersection of Commercial Finance, Accounting Operations—including Billing and Revenue Recognition—Treasury, Legal, Sales, Customer Success, AI Infra / DC, and Deployment, you will ensure commercial commitments become invoiceable milestones, revenue-recognisable outputs, and collectable cash. Working closely with Accounting Operations, you will orchestrate the cross-functional revenue execution process while Accounting Operations retains ownership of billing execution, technical revenue recognition, and accounting controls.

This is a business-critical, senior builder role with regular exposure to Finance and Operations leadership. You will establish the operating cadence that gives leaders clear visibility over billing readiness, liquidity-critical customer cash, delivery-linked blockers, SLA / performance credit exposure, and unresolved execution risks.

## What you'll be doing

****Commitment-to-Cash operating model****

* Build and run Nscale’s Commitment-to-Cash operating model from approved commercial commitment through billing readiness, revenue recognition inputs, cash visibility, and execution reporting.
* Establish the contract-to-finance handoff process, including minimum data standards, source hierarchy, ownership, turnaround expectations, and escalation routes.
* Run the weekly Commitment-to-Cash cadence, ensuring blockers to billing, revenue recognition, cash collection, customer finance onboarding, and acceptance milestones are visible, owned, and escalated.
* Present regularly to senior Finance and Operations leadership on signed deal readiness, billing blockers, liquidity-critical cash timing, execution risks, and required escalations.
* Design pragmatic dashboards, trackers, and control routines that work immediately while building scalable operating discipline.

****Contract handoff, finance readiness, and revenue execution****

* Translate signed contracts, order forms, and amendments into finance-operable billing milestones, revenue recognition inputs, and cash timing assumptions.
* Identify and track billing triggers, acceptance dependencies, PO / portal requirements, payment terms, termination windows, service credits, delay penalties, and performance credits.
* Coordinate with Customer Success / Commercial Operations and other onboarding owners to complete customer finance onboarding dependencies on time.
* Partner with Accounting Operations on invoice issuance, technical revenue recognition assessments, and related controls; Treasury on cash timing; and Legal on contract terms affecting Finance execution.
* Maintain a complete, controlled, and auditable view of what has been committed, what can be billed, when revenue can be recognised, and when cash is expected.

****Cash, liquidity, risk exposure, and executive reporting****

* Own the Commitment-to-Cash / RBC dashboard, invoice milestone tracker, and open blocker log.
* Track advance / prepayment billing, recurring billing, cash due, overdue or disputed balances, and revenue or cash at risk.
* Drive execution visibility for material advance / prepayment invoices, tracking contract triggers, PO / portal readiness, invoice issuance, due dates, disputes, and collection risks.
* Provide Treasury, FP&A, and senior Finance leadership with reliable visibility over liquidity-critical customer cash timing.
* Quantify and escalate financial exposure from delay penalties, performance credits, service credits, acceptance slippage, and SLA obligations.

****Controls and continuous improvement****

* Deliver monthly executive reporting on signed deal readiness, billing blockers, cash exposure, SLA / service credit exposure, and unresolved execution risks.
* Maintain audit-ready evidence of handoffs, trigger evidence, approval status, blocker ownership, and unresolved issues.
* Feed execution learnings into Commercial Finance, FP&A, Accounting Operations, and governance to improve pricing, contract terms, approval gates, and operating controls.

****Capacity monetisation****

* Link contracted or allocated capacity to customer commitments, revenue phasing, billing readiness, and cash timing.
* Partner with Commercial Finance to ensure capacity monetisation execution reflects approved economics, customer commitments, and opportunity-cost decisions.
* Work with AI Infra / DC and Deployment to maintain visibility over committed capacity status, expected go-live timing, acceptance milestones, and billing readiness.
* Track capacity-to-revenue conversion, highlighting where allocated or contracted capacity is not yet billing, revenue-recognisable, or cash-generating.
* Escalate capacity monetisation blockers that delay revenue conversion, customer cash collection, or forecast delivery.

* Experience supporting high-value advance billing, complex invoice milestones, or liquidity-critical cash collection processes is preferred.
* Experience building or operating SOX / ICFR-ready, audit-ready controls across order-to-cash, revenue operations, billing, or finance transformation is preferred.

* Comfort operating in a high-growth, ambiguous environment where processes are still being institutionalised.
* Experience in AI infrastructure, cloud, data centres, enterprise SaaS, telecoms, hardware, or capital-intensive B2B contracting is preferred.

* Identify and develop data champions within business units, creating a network of advocates who promote good data practice.

* Set clear objectives, provide regular feedback, and support the professional development of all direct reports.

* Build a high-performing, collaborative data team culture aligned with the broader IT function.

Additional Duties

* Take on other evolving responsibilities as required.

* Uphold the Opera values.

* Significant experience in data architecture, data engineering, or analytics leadership, ideally within a multi-entity, multi-jurisdictional environment.

* Proven track record of owning enterprise data platforms – data warehouses, data lakes, and integration layers – from design through to operational management.

* Strong hands-on technical skills across data modelling, ETL/integration, and reporting and BI tooling (e.g. Microsoft Fabric, Power BI), alongside the ability to operate strategically.

* Sound understanding of data governance, data quality, and lineage practices, and of data protection legislation relevant to a regulated financial services group.

* Experience contributing to or shaping AI strategy, with an understanding of the data foundations – architecture, governance, model risk – that responsible AI adoption requires.

* Strong stakeholder management skills, able to translate business requirements into technical solutions and engage credibly with senior leadership and business teams.

* Experience building and leading a data team, with a track record of developing data engineers and data analysts.

* Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, acquisitive environment, integrating data estates from newly acquired businesses.

* Head of Business Applications – integrations and data requirements for business systems

* Head of Security – data security, classification, access controls, and compliance alignment

**Oxford Nanopore Technologies**

**Location: Oxford, UK**

**Role Type: Full time, hybrid**

**About Us:**

Our goal is to bring the widest benefits to society through enabling the analysis of anything, by anyone, anywhere. 

The company has developed a new generation of nanopore-based sensing technology for faster, information rich, accessible and affordable molecular analysis. The first application is DNA/RNA sequencing, and the technology is in development for the analysis of other types of molecules including proteins. The technology is used to understand and characterise the biology of humans and diseases such as cancer, plants, animals, bacteria, viruses, and whole environments. 

With a thriving culture of ambition and strong innovation goals, Oxford Nanopore is a UK headquartered company with global operations and customers in more than 125 countries!

We are looking for an individual with expertise in bioinformatics, with particular experience of working with human sequencing data, to join our Applications team as an Applications Bioinformatician.

**The Role:**

The Proof of Concept Clinical Applications team works within R&D to evaluate the feasibility of novel applications of Oxford Nanopore sequencing examining human disease, with a particular focus on rare disease.

As a member of the Proof of Concept Clinical Applications team, the successful candidate will primarily interpret sequencing data generated by lab scientists within the team, in a range of biological contexts aiming to showcase the abilities of the technology and develop proof of concept workflows to fill market niches. You should also be prepared to work with others across the wider Applications group to share expertise and collaborate where appropriate and to communicate your findings to internal stakeholders through presentations, reports and discussions in meetings.

As this role is within a multi-disciplinary team, the position is offered as hybrid, with an expectation of being in the Oxford office at least two days a week. 

**Main responsibilities include:**

* Initial investigations of sequencing data to identify the potential of an experimental design.
* Performing evaluation of appropriate bioinformatics tools for a given application, and carrying out defined custom analysis where needed.
* Independently deliver assigned analysis tasks while escalating priorities, design decisions and blockers.
* Support evaluation and development of defined proof-of-concept analyses; seek guidance on analysis design, interpretation and roadblocks.
* Developing initial proof-of-concept pipelines for analysis of DNA, cDNA and direct RNA sequencing data using ONT’s nanopore sensing platform, with regular guidance from a senior bioinformatician/manager, including task prioritization and mentoring.
* Working collaboratively with laboratory-based scientists in the group to contribute suggestions on experimental design, to interpret the data generated in the appropriate biological context, and to report the results clearly.
* Working with the team to make analysis and figure contributions to conference talks and posters.
* Working closely with other applications groups in different locations to keep up-to-date with the latest developments, provide feedback and incorporate them into analyses where appropriate.

**What We're Looking For...**

To be successful you'll have an MSc or equivalent experience, involving analysis and visualization of DNA and RNA sequence data, plus an undergraduate degree in a Biological Science or Computer Science. Additionally, having a PhD or job experience in a relevant field would be beneficial.  
   
We'll expect you to have a track record of successfully performing appropriate bioinformatics sequence analyses for at least a couple of research projects and awareness of the whole experimental process, from the initial experimental concept to biologically meaningful results. In addition, you'll have some practical experience of handling and analysing large human datasets, ideally in a clinical research setting. An awareness of the concepts of assembly, phasing and variant calling, and how to perform them would be beneficial. You would be working closely with lab scientists to continually refine the experimental and analytical approaches. Therefore, the role is a mixture of collaboration for project design and independent analysis, though the bioinformatics will be supported as appropriate. An important part of the role is also keeping up to date with advances in genetics and genomics. 

**Specific technical experience that would be expected for the role:**

* Programming experience (python, R)
* Graphical visualisation experience
* Experience of using a terminal interface, HPC and scheduling
* Familiarity with common bioinformatics file formats
* Experience with common bioinformatic tools (e.g. samtools, bedtools, IGV)
* Package management (conda)
* Version control (git, Github/Gitlab)

**Specific technical experience that would be beneficial for the role:**

* Experience with Oxford Nanopore sequencing data
* Experience with human clinical data regulations
* Experience with assembly, phasing and/or variant calling
* Claude or Codex experience
* Workflow management systems (nextflow, snakemake)
* Cloud usage (AWS EC2 and s3)
* Statistics

You're also someone with good communication and interpersonal skills with an enthusiasm for technology. You feel confident discussing and presenting data within the team and with other colleagues. You are versatile, have excellent problem-solving and time management skills and the ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously. It will be important to be able to work efficiently both independently, supported by regular check-ins, and as part of a team. 

This role will suit a curious, organized individual with the ability to adapt based on changing business needs and looking for a supportive environment in which to further develop their skills.
